defect_discovery: Real human review found that review-package links targeted v0/index.html through v3/index.html while artifacts live under variants/v0/index.html through variants/v3/index.html.

root_causes.duplicated_location: The sandbox /workspace mount maps directly to the host /home/harshdev/HermesWorkspaces directory. Treating /workspace as the host filesystem root and appending home/harshdev/HermesWorkspaces created the duplicated hierarchy.
root_causes.broken_review_links: The Phase-2 review package was hand-written with hrefs relative to an assumed vN/ sibling. No generator derived links from the runner's real artifact locations under variants/vN/, and no link-resolution regression test existed.

remediation.generator_rule: Use node:path.relative(caseDir, artifact) after verifying the artifact exists; never hand-write variant hrefs.
remediation.regression_red: 4 href failures on the original package
